$comment: Extra flake inputs from GitHub. Only offered when the output format is a flake. 'module' is added to the modules list of the nixosConfiguration. %%REL%% is replaced with the release branch for the selected channel.

items.name: Home Manager
items.desc: Manages your dotfiles and per-user packages declaratively, in the same rebuild as the system.

items.name: nixos-hardware
items.desc: Ready-made quirk fixes for hundreds of specific laptop and desktop models.
items.note: Swap the module for the one matching your machine, e.g. nixos-hardware.nixosModules.framework-13-7040-amd. The full list is in the repository README.

items.name: sops-nix
items.desc: Keeps secrets encrypted inside your git repository and decrypts them at activation time.
items.note: The right answer to every 'create this password file by hand' note elsewhere in this config.

items.name: agenix
items.desc: Secret management built on age and your existing SSH host keys.

items.name: disko
items.desc: Declares your partition layout in Nix and formats the disks for you at install time.
items.note: You still need to write a disk layout module. This only adds the input and the module.

items.name: Lanzaboote
items.desc: UEFI Secure Boot for NixOS, with your own keys.
items.note: Requires enrolling your own Secure Boot keys and turning systemd-boot off. Read the quick start before enabling it.

items.name: Stylix
items.desc: Derives a consistent colour scheme, fonts and wallpaper across every application from one image.

items.name: nix-flatpak
items.desc: Declares which Flatpaks to install, so they survive a reinstall like everything else.

items.name: impermanence
items.desc: Wipes the root filesystem on every boot and keeps only what you explicitly declare.
items.note: This genuinely deletes anything you forget to declare. Read the README fully first.

items.name: NUR
items.desc: The Nix User Repository - community packages that are not in nixpkgs.
items.note: NUR packages are built from user repositories and are not reviewed by nixpkgs maintainers.

items.name: nix-index-database
items.desc: Prebuilt index so `comma` and command-not-found can tell you which package provides a binary.

items.name: Chaotic Nyx
items.desc: Bleeding-edge packages and kernels, prebuilt in a binary cache.
items.note: Adds a third-party binary cache. Only enable it if you trust that cache to serve your binaries.

items.name: musnix
items.desc: Real-time kernel tuning for low-latency audio production.

items.name: Jovian NixOS
items.desc: Steam Deck hardware support and the SteamOS game-mode session.
